historical_information: Prior P13 metadata audits and published task methods inspected; no new P14 eligibility counts computed. P13 held-out scores were exposed and cannot be fresh P14 confirmation.
context_priority: C aligned measured behavioral state only

IBL.anatomical_target: Single-probe medial prefrontal composite: ACAd, ACAv, PL, ILA and exact laminar descendants only
IBL.anatomy_justification: P14 estimates a same-population within-mouse context interaction across a predeclared medial frontal sampling target, not P13's single-leaf anatomical effect. Same-probe subregions may be combined; no cross-probe/session pooling. All leaf compositions remain reported; no uniform PFC mechanism or fine-region replication inferred. MOs and orbital/lateral regions are excluded.
IBL.units_justification: Ten simultaneous provider-good units is a new engineering screen for a future fixed2D representation (20 readout coefficients per invariant model) and composition/unit-removal checks. It does not certify physiological quality, statistical power, optimal dimensionality or rescue the former20-unit leaf-region failure.
IBL.context_causality: Experimenter-defined uncued block schedule, fixed before each prediction; not direct evidence that the mouse knows the true prior. No neural-inferred context or future-choice predictor.
IBL.window_justification: Fixed stimulus-anchored early-task prediction with event/causal movement controls; not a premovement/decision-free or causal-mechanism claim. Future100ms count bins and past-only histories are proposals, not extracted neural data.
IBL.usable_trial: Provider bwm_include; finite interval/stimulus/goCue/feedback; start<=stimulus<=goCue<=feedback<=stop; stimulus+0.5<=stop; stimulus/goCue inside interval; no saturation_stim_plus06. Missing required mask/identity/timing is unknown/fail, not accepted. Future source support/clock and training-only QC gates remain mandatory.
IBL.block_definition: Maximal contiguous original-trial probabilityLeft run BEFORE filtering. Unknown/neutral values break runs; excluded trials never merge separated blocks. Finite stimulus timestamps must increase in original session order.
IBL.small_run_handling: Whole-block temporal cut is defined on ALL original nonneutral runs before exclusions. Only runs with>=15valid trials contribute primary context/half observation counts; excluded small runs remain in the table and never bridge separated blocks.
IBL.partition_proposal: Split all nonneutral block runs chronologically at floor(K/2), preserve whole blocks; early runs for A/C calibration, late runs for B/E or D scoring. No random interleaved trial split.
IBL.observation_justification: At least120 usable trials/context with at least60 per temporal half gives a future600 scored100ms bins/context, and at least300 bins/context for calibration before unit multiplicity. Min15 per run avoids fragmentary blocks; two separated runs/context and whole-block halves reduce perfect context/order confounding. These are metadata feasibility floors, not power guarantees or inherited400-trial/120epoch rules.
IBL.one_population_per_mouse: Among metadata-eligible rows choose most provider-good target units, then greatest minimum four context-half cell count, then eid/pid lexical; no outcome scores. No allocation executed in M0.
IBL.nuisance_overlap: Report context distributions of signed contrast, choice, previous-trial choice/feedback, movement/reaction latency and chronological quartiles. Per-mouse common stimulus values and order occupancy are descriptive diagnostics; no new data-driven admission cutoff. Missing essential nuisance metadata limits feasibility verdict.
IBL.additional_metadata_reason: Existing frozen table lacks stimulus/choice/reward fields required to examine P14 context-nuisance overlap. New eid+stimOn columns verify exact old row order, not another full original audit. Same object ETag/size required.

KI.reuse: Existing reviewed identity/unit/epoch/header/workbook/source audit; no new NWB download
KI.source_specific_screen: At least10 anatomically matching units/single probe, independently timestamped within-session contexts with>=60 event observations each and separate calibration/scoring support. Unknown unit-quality/context schema stays unknown; do not call anatomical units good.
KI.context_design: First examine source Context task with documented block labels; report task-stratified A/B/C possibilities and same-animal cross-task overlap. Different sessions/tasks are not interchangeable primary contexts. Do not combine strata to manufacture16 eligible mice.
KI.historical_background: 000473 remains exposed P13 background only, not a fresh independent confirmation set

animal_reason: Mouse is independent unit;16 metadata candidates is a feasibility floor, not an effect-power calculation. Future physiology and access checks can reduce it. No unit/session/probe pseudo-replication.

additional_datasets.trigger: Only if reviewed IBL/KI route scientifically inadequate or critically unresolved
additional_datasets.selection: Document PFC and real within-mouse context from primary methods before any inventory. Register source-specific rules before counts; no dozens-of-datasets search.

decision: Exactly one of FEASIBLE_CONTEXT_PFC_COHORT / FEASIBLE_WITH_EXPLICIT_DESIGN_LIMITATIONS / INCONCLUSIVE_METADATA / DATA_INSUFFICIENT. Missing essential metadata never counts as passed physiological eligibility.
M1: Propose only; freeze hypotheses/complexity/statistics/nulls/independent animal allocation/one-shot final design separately before any neural experiment. No unstable autoregressive Bstar null inheritance.
